summary: This week got weird fast: General Neil McCasland, who allegedly had insider UFO knowledge, has gone missing, and while investigative journalist Ross Coulthart called it a "grave crisis," the General's wife is now pushing back against what she sees as sensationalized UFO claims swirling around his disappearance. Meanwhile, Trump's promised release of classified alien files remains MIA despite his earlier vows to go public with the goods, and celebrity Priyanka Chopra Jonas weighed in with theories about extraterrestrial intervention in ancient Hindu texts. On the brighter side, the UAP community has two big things to look forward to: Contact in the Desert 2026 (May 28) is shaping up to be the year's largest UFO conference, and Congress has until June 30 to brief on UAP findings for the FY2026 NDAA. The disclosure front keeps giving us cliffhangers, plot twists, and broken promises in equal measure.
